turns.text: I need matching plant-shop ads in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9. Include exactly: “Fern House”, “Weekend Plant Sale”, “20% off all indoor plants”, “Saturday & Sunday”, “Visit 24 Willow Lane”. Use leafy plants and a clean green-and-cream look. Keep every line easy to read in all three, especially the address—rearrange things instead of shrinking the whole design.

item.tests: Preserves complete, readable ad copy and visual hierarchy when adapting one design to three substantially different canvas shapes.

answer_sheet.Exact copy: Fern House; Weekend Plant Sale; 20% off all indoor plants; Saturday & Sunday; Visit 24 Willow Lane
answer_sheet.Style and imagery: Leafy plants, clean green-and-cream styling, consistent across the set.
answer_sheet.Text priority: Every line must remain easy to read, including the address; rearrange the layout rather than shrinking the entire design.
answer_sheet.Sale dates: Use Saturday & Sunday as written; no calendar dates are needed.

must_haves: Three finished images have the requested 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9 aspect ratios.
All five specified text strings appear correctly and completely in every variant.
Every text line, including 'Visit 24 Willow Lane', is comfortably readable when each image is viewed at its delivered size without zooming.
Text has clear contrast against its background and is not obscured by leaves or other text.
No text is clipped, pushed against the canvas edge or distorted to fit.
The variants retain matching leafy imagery and green-and-cream styling while adjusting text placement or line breaks to suit each shape.

dialog.agent:
Happy to make these. One question first:

**Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?**

If you know these yet, they'd help too:
- **Images or short videos?**
- **Any words you want on the ads?** For example, your shop's name, a sale, or a tagline. Give me the exact wording, or tell me you want no text.
dialog.why: The assistant asks where the ads will be shown and about format and wording, then waits for the user's answer before making anything.
dialog.user: um a square one, a tall one and a wide one, all matching

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the ads. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits, so all three images were refused and nothing was created.

These were the settings I used, ready to rerun:
- **Formats:** a square (1:1), a tall (9:16) and a wide (16:9) version.
- **Matching look:** the same description for all three. It's a bright, sunny plant shop with monstera, fiddle leaf fig, pothos and succulents in terracotta and white pots on light wooden shelves. The colours are cream and sage green.
- **No text** on the images, since you hadn't given me any wording yet.
- **Cheapest free-plan settings:** the flux-2-klein model at 640px, about 5 credits per image (around 15 total).

**To go ahead:**
1. Add credits to your account, or wait for your free credits to refill, then tell me to try again. I'll rerun all three exactly as above.
2. While you're sorting that out, you could send me:
   - your shop name or any words you want on the ads, written exactly as they should appear
   - a style you'd prefer instead, like moody and dark, or minimal and white
   - whether you'd rather have short videos than images. Video costs a lot more: about 24 credits per second.
